title: Wso2am: pre-authentication attacker could leverage unbounded symbol value caching to cause resource exhaustion leading…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package allows a pre-authentication attacker to exploit unbounded symbol value caching, resulting in resource exhaustion and denial of service. The flaw affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. A fix is available in these versions. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.5 and does not impact confidentiality or integrity but causes availability disruption.
